+from program import wrap
+
+def test_short_text_returns_itself():
+    assert wrap("hello", 10) == ["hello"]
+
+def test_remainder_must_be_included():
+    text = "abc def ghi jkl"
+    cols = 5
+    result = wrap(text, cols)
+    # concatenation must equal original
+    assert "".join(result) == text
+    # last chunk present
+    assert result[-1] == " jkl" or result[-1] == "jkl" or "jkl" in result[-1]
+    assert len(result) >= 1
+
+def test_expected_last_item_present_case0():
+    # trimmed version of case_0 last chunk check
+    text = "The leaves did not stir on the trees, grasshoppers chirruped, and the monotonous hollow sound of the sea rising up"
+    cols = 50
+    result = wrap(text, cols)
+    assert "".join(result) == text
